# Slack Modal — Phase 1 / Builder 3 status note

Returned by the Builder 3 isolated worktree (`slack-modal/builder-3`,
branched from `feature/slack-modal` at `a75bc8d`). Orchestrator should
fold this into the canonical `slack-modal-progress.md` Phase 1 / Builder 3
entry on merge.

- [DONE] Phase 1 / Builder 3 — `/api/slack/commands` (6 commands) +
  proposal helper + caller-side fuzzy match.
  - 4 files created (route + route test + proposal helper + helper test) +
    1 small co-located route test helper file
    (`route-test-helpers.ts`) for HMAC-signed form-body request
    construction (parallel to `events/route-test-helpers.ts`).
  - 75 tests added (50 copy + 5 proposal unit + 1 proposal DB-skipped + 20
    route + 4 fuzzy guard already counted in baseline). Net new vs
    baseline: 21 tests passing in this worktree (1 skipped).
  - Stub view builders inside `route.ts` carry a `TODO(orchestrator)`
    comment for Phase 1 merge swap-in (Builder 4/5/6 outputs replace).
  - Lint zero errors. Full suite green: 2383 passed / 19 skipped.
  - HMAC pattern mirrors `/api/slack/events`. Slash arg parsed via
    `URLSearchParams(rawBody)`.
  - Multi-match hint computation matrix tested for all branches: 0
    candidates → undefined; 1 candidate → undefined; N candidates →
    `formatMultiMatchHint` string with N substituted; absent parent name
    → undefined.
  - Edit flow target lookup: ID match (ulid pattern), single fuzzy match,
    multi-match (modal opens with target-entity picker), no-match
    (ephemeral via `formatEditNoMatch`).
  - Slash-fuzzy threshold: 0.4 (looser than the default 0.6 in
    `fuzzy-match.ts`) so partial slash names like "Brand" surface
    "Brand Refresh" + "Brand Strategy" as multi-match candidates.
    Documented inline as `SLASH_FUZZY_THRESHOLD`.

## Open follow-ups (out-of-scope for Builder 3)

- Stub view builders inside `route.ts` need to be replaced with imports
  from Builders 4/5/6 outputs after Phase 1 merge — the
  `TODO(orchestrator)` comment marks the integration point. Tests assert
  `__debug` shape (kind/mode/proposalId/baselineHint/multiMatchHint
  pass-through); when real builders land, those assertions can be moved
  to the per-builder modal tests and `__debug` removed.
- `proxy.ts` allowlist edit for `/api/slack/commands` is owned by
  Builder 2 (per the dispatch prompt). NOT touched here to avoid merge
  conflicts.
- The route currently passes `parentNameCandidate` on the proposal
  `args` so the modal can pre-fill the picker. The actual picker
  pre-fill logic lives in the Builder 4/5 view builders — they read
  `args.parentNameCandidate` (or whatever final arg name the orchestrator
  picks) and seed the `external_select` initial value.
- `SLASH_FUZZY_THRESHOLD = 0.4` is local to the route. If the
  view-submission validator (Builder 9) wants to reuse the same
  threshold for title-collision soft-warns, lift the constant into
  `src/lib/runway/fuzzy-match.ts` (or a shared module) at that point.
- One pre-existing `posttooluse-validate` Next.js linter false positive
  fired three times: the validator misidentifies a `URLSearchParams`
  variable named `params` as a Next.js 16 dynamic-route segment object.
  This is a static route (`/api/slack/commands`) with no
  `[slug]`-style dynamic segments, so the recommendation does not apply.
  No code change needed; flagged here so the orchestrator can suppress
  if the validator surfaces it on PR review.
